svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 10 · Santa Cruz · 03/12 Steamer Lane (Rare)
svg.desc: The point break below the little lighthouse. Lean on the cliff rail and count the sets. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
